reuse.why: Ignores the exported getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts, which already resolves missing, numeric and ranged amounts and is used by schedules/app.ts, forecast and schedule-template.

duplication.why: The inline nested ternary re-encodes getScheduledAmount's missing/number/range dispatch, with a diverging tie rule (> instead of >=).

placement.why: The field is added in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, which is the right layer for API shaping, though the rule itself belongs in the shared helper it should call.

scope.why: Only the API model type, its mapping and a focused test are changed.

maintainability.why: A second definition of the expected-amount rule in the API layer will drift from the app's rule; a nested ternary is also harder to read than a helper call.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes expectedAmount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount(schedule._amount).

disguised_duplication.where: api-models.ts: getScheduledAmount's logic rewritten as a nested ternary with a different comparison (> vs >=), not a literal copy.
